source_name: Биро за јавни набавки (БЈН) — Водич за негативни референци
why_relevant: Defines the legal mechanics and location of the negative-reference (de-facto blacklist) register — required to interpret and correctly harvest the exclusion list of economic operators.

source_name: Биро за јавни набавки — Годишни извештаи (procurement statistics)
why_relevant: Annual system-wide statistics: volumes, procedure types, competition levels, plus the 'red flags' risk-indicator report — the baseline for sizing the MK procurement market and benchmarking sector shares.

source_name: Биро за јавни набавки — институционална страница (Министерство за финансии)
why_relevant: Confirms institutional placement and links to BJN outputs; useful for authoritative contact points and for FOI requests about registers not published online.

source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Банки, штедилници и останати финансиски институции
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained lists of licensed banks, savings houses and other financial institutions — the authoritative actor registry that association membership lists must be reconciled against (associations do not cover all licensees, e.g. payment institutions).

source_name: НБРСМ — Листа на водечки броеви на банките (bank leading numbers)
why_relevant: Canonical bank identifier list (payment-system leading numbers) — ideal join key for reconciling bank names across association lists, tender notices and registry records.

source_name: НБРСМ — Кредитен регистар / Македонско кредитно биро (МКБ)
why_relevant: Credit-registry infrastructure page; the Macedonian Credit Bureau is itself an MBA member and a procurement-relevant financial-infrastructure entity (alongside KIBS) that buys IT/payments systems.

source_name: Асоцијација за е-трговија на Македонија (ecommerce.mk)
why_relevant: Only MK e-commerce association; aggregates merchants, PSPs and card-scheme partners (works with Mastercard, publishes NBRSM card-transaction analyses) — a pointer to the payments-acceptance actor set that neither MBA nor MASIT covers.

source_name: zk.mk — директориум на институции и организации
why_relevant: Third-party MK organisation directory carrying entries for MBA, DKZJN and similar bodies — a cheap cross-check/aliasing source for official names and contact data.

source_name: slobodenpristap.mk — FOI request platform (public bodies index)
why_relevant: Indexes MK public bodies and past freedom-of-information requests/answers — the route to obtain registers (e.g. supplier or negative-reference lists) that are not published in machine-readable form.

source_name: Државен завод за статистика (ДЗС) — stat.mk
why_relevant: National statistics office provides business-demography and ICT/financial-sector activity statistics used to size the supplier population and sanity-check registry-derived counts.

source_name: ДКЖЈН годишни извештаи (annual reports of the Appeals Commission)
why_relevant: Annual reports aggregate appeal volumes by contracting authority and by subject of procurement, plus outcome statistics (annulled vs upheld awards). Gives a fast structural read of which public buyers of financial/payment services are most litigated, and a stable yearly time series for trend work.

source_name: ДКЖЈН application instance (dkzjn.sorsix.com)
why_relevant: Appears in search results as a Sorsix-built application instance for the Appeals Commission — plausibly the actual e-appeals / decision-search application behind the institutional site. If it exposes a searchable case register, it is the highest-value structured entry point in this cell.

source_name: Државен завод за ревизија (State Audit Office) — Ревизорски извештаи
why_relevant: Final audit reports on ministries, municipalities, funds and public enterprises routinely name specific contracts, suppliers, contracted amounts and irregularities in procurement of banking and payment-operations services (платен промет, банкарски провизии, кредитни задолжувања, гаранции). Audit findings expose contract terms and pricing that no notice publishes.

source_name: ДЗР — Планирани ревизии (planned audits register)
source_subtype: audit plan register with query-string filters
why_relevant: Forward-looking: tells you which entities and which themes will be audited before the findings exist. Early-warning signal for where contract-level disclosure about banking/payment arrangements will appear 6-18 months out.

source_name: ДЗР taxonomy pages for oversight bodies (e.g. term/606 ДКЖЈН, term/537 КЗК, term/528 ДКСК)
why_relevant: The State Audit Office indexes its own reports by audited entity via taxonomy term IDs. These pages are a clean pointer structure: one stable URL per institution, listing every audit report on it. Enumerating term IDs gives a machine-readable map from institution to audit-report set — including the oversight bodies in this cell and, more importantly, the banks' public-sector counterparties.

source_name: Комисија за заштита на конкуренцијата (KZK) — Commission for Protection of Competition
why_relevant: Publishes concentration notifications (известување за концентрација) and decisions in abuse-of-dominance / cartel cases. Directly relevant to bank fee coordination (interchange, платен промет надоместоци), card-scheme and acquirer market structure, and M&A among banks/PSPs/POS vendors. Also relevant to A2 where bidder collusion in tenders is investigated.

source_name: KZK 'Линкови' page — institutional link directory
why_relevant: Curated list of peer regulators and international competition networks maintained by the authority itself. Cheap snowball surface for further oversight actors and for regional comparators.

source_name: Државна комисија за спречување на корупцијата (ДКСК) — State Commission for Prevention of Corruption
source_subtype: anti-corruption authority — case and register publisher
why_relevant: Opens cases on suspicion of corruption in public procurement, publishes case initiations, opinions and referrals to the prosecution, and hosts the lobbyist register and asset/interest declarations. Its procurement-related case files name contracting authorities and suppliers and describe the disputed award mechanics.

source_name: Управен суд на РСМ (Administrative Court) — Одлуки
why_relevant: The judicial review layer above ДКЖЈН: appeals commission decisions are contested before the Administrative Court and Higher Administrative Court. Judgments restate the full procedural history including bid values, technical-specification disputes and the reasoning for annulling an award — the deepest publicly available detail on a contested banking/payments tender.

source_name: Агенција за заштита на правото на слободен пристап до информациите од јавен карактер (АСПИ) — holders-of-information directory
why_relevant: Registry of every 'holder of public information' with its FOI officers and contact details, including ДКЖЈН (entry 30116) and ДКСК (entry 30119). This is the operational key to legally obtaining appeal decisions, audit working papers and case documents that are not proactively published — and АСПИ's own appeal decisions reveal when institutions refuse.

source_name: Јавно обвинителство на РСМ (Public Prosecutor's Office) — cooperation with the State Audit Office
source_subtype: prosecution service — press and case announcements
why_relevant: The prosecution acts on ДЗР audit reports under a formalised cooperation arrangement; its press releases and indictment announcements name contracts, amounts and suppliers when procurement irregularities escalate criminally. Confirms which audit findings were serious enough to move, and adds names not present in the audit text.

source_name: Уставен суд на РСМ — Одлуки и решенија
why_relevant: Constitutional challenges to procurement, competition and payment-services legislation change the rules under which tenders and bank fee regulation operate. Low frequency but high impact, and the searchable decision list is paginated and crawlable.

source_name: Sakam Da Kazam (СДК.мк) and Makfax — investigative coverage of procurement oversight findings
why_relevant: These outlets reliably report ЦГК monitoring findings, ДЗР audit conclusions and ДКЖЈН appeal statistics with figures and named entities, and often surface documents faster than the institutions publish them. Useful as a low-latency tripwire that a new oversight document exists.
